title: Guaranteed investment returns
description: Do not promise or guarantee a specific investment return.

title: Risk-free investment claims
description: Do not describe a market investment as having no risk or zero risk.

title: Past performance disclaimer
description: Investment marketing material should include the required past-performance disclaimer.

title: Unsubstantiated superlative claims
description: Claims such as best, safest, or number one should have substantiation.

title: Misleading certainty language
description: Avoid presenting uncertain investment outcomes as certain.

title: Unbalanced benefit and risk presentation
description: Material investment benefits should not be presented while omitting material risk context.

title: Unsupported endorsement
description: Do not imply a regulator endorses or approves a product without evidence.

title: Misleading liquidity representation
description: Do not claim an investment can always be withdrawn immediately unless supported by its terms.

title: Omitted fee information
description: Material fees and charges should be clearly disclosed in applicable offering material.

title: Misleading comparative claim
description: Comparative claims should identify a fair and supportable comparison basis.
